id: How to Lose a Guy in 10 Days (2003)

facts.text: Ten days, one column. Tonight I'm cooking him something awful and he has to eat every bite with a smile.
facts.why: Andie never cooks Ben a terrible dinner in the plot read. Her tricks are the Knicks game, the scrapbook, Princess Sophia, the love fern, the poker night and the puppy.
facts.fix: Ten days, one column. Tonight Ben meets my worst habits, and he has to say he loves every one.

fix_note.text: Ten days, one column. Tonight Ben meets my worst habits, and he has to say he loves every one.

facts.text: Ben's family card game. Bluff the last round.
facts.why: The plot has a poker night with Ben's friends and a Staten Island family weekend, but no family card game.
facts.fix: Ben's family weekend on Staten Island. Smile through the last round.

facts.why: The plot names a diamond company campaign Ben wants to lead. A 'pink' diamond is not mentioned.

vibe.verdict: Magazine lunchroom is a clear idea, but it is mostly generic office food and skips the film's funniest set pieces.
missing: The scrapbook of future children and the Photoshopped family album
Andie's vegetarian 'I wish I ate meat' moment at the game
Poker night where Andie crashes in
The Knicks game she makes him miss
ideas: Swap 'Composure office smoked salmon bagels' for 'Love fern salad' (the dead fern).
Swap 'Courtside ginger lime shandy' note for 'Ben misses the end of the Knicks game'.
Swap 'Ham and pea arancini' for 'Princess Sophia pastry' (joke name).
